quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon press release: Infineon completes acquisition of C2i Semiconductors to (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon completed its acquisition of C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based company specializing in software-defined multiphase controllers and smart power stages for AI data center applications; the C2i team becomes part of Infineon's Power Systems division. The combined teams will develop power delivery solutions for AI infrastructure, including future Substrate Integrated Voltage Regulators (SIVR), across Infineon's silicon, SiC and GaN portfolio and vertical power delivery solutions. Adam White, President of the Power Systems division: 'Completing this acquisition marks an important milestone for our AI power business and our innovation activities in India.' Infineon currently employs approximately 2,800 people in India.
quarterly_data.figure: acquisition completed 5 October 2026; approximately 2,800 employees in India
